party.title: Study & Work Party
party.description: A collaborative room where members study or work together with shared Pomodoro timers and a focus leaderboard.

code.description: Memorable 6-8 character party code to join the room.

createdBy.description: Unique device or user identifier who created the party.

createdByName.description: Display name of the party creator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the party was created.

memberCount.description: Count of members currently in the party.

member.title: Party Member
member.description: A participant in a party tracking their Pomodoro focus minutes and real-time status.

avatarColor.description: Hex or theme color for the avatar badge.

totalFocusMinutes.description: Cumulative Pomodoro focus minutes logged in this party.

completedSessions.description: Number of completed focus pomodoro intervals.

currentStatus.description: Real-time focus status of the member.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp of most recent activity or focus heartbeat.

joinedAt.description: Timestamp when the member joined this party.

message.title: Party Chat Message
message.description: A chat message sent within a study/work party room.

partyId.description: ID of the party room this message belongs to.

senderId.description: Unique participant identifier who sent the message.

senderAvatarColor.description: Avatar theme color of the sender.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

/parties/{partyId}.description: Top-level collection storing study & work parties accessible by code.

/parties/{partyId}/members/{memberId}.description: Subcollection storing members and live leaderboard stats for a party.

/parties/{partyId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection storing real-time chat messages for a party.
